projects.title: Reconstruction of Several Tenemental scheme under Housing For All/Pradhan Mantry Awas Yojana(HFA/PMAY)= 40+ scheme
Structural Assessment & Re-evaluation of several tenemental schemes (Phase I, II & III) - 33 Schemes
projects.description:
Evaluation / Validation of Recommendations given by committees of TNUHDB

Carry out a detailed condition survey of interior and exterior of the buildings / structures to assess the following:

(a) External damages, distress, deformities, deteriorations, deficiencies, discontinuities in the critical structural elements.

(b) Physical condition of the non-structural elements for its intended functional effectiveness and efficacy.

(c) Present status of the building services for its functional effectiveness and efficacy.

(d) Determine the necessity and carryout appropriate Non-destructive / Partial destructive tests at structural elements as dictated by the site condition.

Carryout an indicative Cost Benefit Comparison of the repair / refurbishment vs reconstruction of the structures to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of retention option.

Analyse the findings from the above to cumulatively assess the overall adequacy of the scheme and arrive at the conclusion either to be Repaired / Refurbished or Reconstructed.

Thorough quantification of groundwater extraction and its repercussions on the aquifers is undertaken. The project unearths globally and nationally acclaimed practices, integrating established techniques for sustainable water management and preservation, to ensure effective aquifer conservation.
keyHighlights: Comprehensive Aquifer Assessment: The study thoroughly evaluates coastal aquifers, examining historical and present conditions, to comprehend the impact of urban development.
Urbanization Analysis: By analyzing population growth and development trends, the project uncovers how urbanization affects aquifers and their sustainability.

Guided Conservation Strategy: Drawing from global and national practices, the study formulates a robust framework to preserve aquifers, offering actionable recommendations for long-term sustainability.
Urban planning guidelines for Aquifer recharge area : Based on the ground water extraction data and CRZ , TNCDBR regulations, comprehensive urban planning guidelines are formulated.
services: Comprehensive assessment of aquifer systems, factoring in urban development consequences.
In-depth analysis of population growth trends and development characteristics, scrutinizing spatial implications.
Quantification of groundwater extraction levels, followed by a meticulous examination of their impact on aquifer sustainability.
Identification and assimilation of best practices from international and national contexts for effective aquifer preservation.
Formulation of comprehensive recommendations and guidelines for urban planning, facilitating long-term resilience and accessibility of aquifers for future generations.

projects.title: Consultancy Services for Preparation of Concept for Area Development Approach for Nagapattinam, as Part of Gati Shakti Initiative due to CPCL’s Cauvery Basin Refinery Project
projects.description:
The Project revolves around Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited's (CPCL) plan to establish a cutting-edge grassroots refinery in Nagapattinam, Tamil Nadu. This refinery caters to the surging demand in the southern region. CPCL, with the support of the Center for Urbanization, Buildings, and Environment (CUBE), seeks to implement a holistic area development approach in 45 villages spanning Nagapattinam and Karaikal districts.

The project involves Concept for Area Development Approach for Nagapattinam as per Gati Shakti’s laid down objectives. The proposed plan shall aim to position Nagapattinam as a growth centre by transforming the town into a vibrant and leading economic hub in the region by leveraging its potential in various sectors and creating a conducive environment through infrastructure development with a focus on inclusive growth and overall well-being of its citizens.
keyHighlights: Economic Impetus: The CPCL's Cauvery Basin Refinery Project is set to invigorate Nagapattinam's economy with an estimated INR 40,000 crore investment, bolstering GDP and generating employment opportunities.
Infrastructure Enhancement: The study identifies and addresses infrastructure gaps in transportation, social services, physical amenities, and heritage, propelling comprehensive growth.

Inclusive Transformation: The proposed area development plan aims to not only support the refinery project but also foster overall economic growth, attract investments, and elevate residents' quality of life.
Integrated Vision: The development plan harmoniously integrates economy, ecology, infrastructure, heritage, and more, setting the foundation for Nagapattinam's multi-industry progress.
Gati Shakti Alignment: The project aligns with the Prime Minister's Gati Shakti National Master Plan, contributing to multi-modal connectivity and holistic development in the region.
services: Analyzing the physical environment, demographics, infrastructure, economy, heritage, and governance.
Conducting SWOT assessment to identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
Assessing infrastructure gaps and projecting required developments.
Formulating a vision statement, accounting for growth areas and project impact.
Crafting an area development plan, addressing economic, ecological, transportation, social, and heritage aspects.

verticals.title: Environment & Sustainability
verticals.description: The E&S vertical at CUBE, with its state of the art laboratory is involved in efforts to develop innovative and cost-effective solutions to treating effluents, managing solid waste, purifying air and recycling water.
verticals.longDescription:
We live in an increasingly urbanized world. It faces significant environmental challenges today due to ruthless, relentless & non-sustainable exploitation of environment by human race. While Urbanization is inevitable, the challenge in the coming years is to do so sensitively, keeping sustainability at the core of all development. Maintaining air & water quality, minimizing carbon emissions & reducing our environmental footprint while we continue to create jobs and industries are the significant problems that we face.

The E&S vertical at CUBE, with its state of the art laboratory is involved in efforts to develop innovative and cost-effective solutions to treating effluents, managing solid waste, purifying air and recycling water.

The city’s developmental goals therefore, must respond to not just the current needs of the society but the future also.

The SMART vertical focuses on all the three aspects, in developing solutions that are holistic socio culturally, technologically and environmentally while employing design thinking & analytics to arrive at a wholesome approach to urban development, be it the supply of basic infrastructure, or data and analytics driven decision making for cities.

Optimizing the design of carrying infrastructure such as roads as well as developing data and technology driven solutions to optimize movement across public & private forms of transport are critical challenges.

The UPT vertical at CUBE is ideally poised to do so, with focus on the varied, multi sectoral and multidimensional aspects of urban issues and transportation planning.

teamMembers.name: Prof. Ashwin Mahalingam
teamMembers.bio:
Dr. Ashwin Mahalingam is an Associate Professor of the Building Technology and Construction Management Division in the Department of Civil Engineering at IIT Madras. He completed his B. Tech in Civil Engineering from IIT Madras in 1998 and went on to do a Masters and Ph.D in Civil Engineering from Stanford University. Following a stint as the Graduate Teaching and Research Assistant at Stanford University and Product Development Lead at GlobeRanger Corporation, Texas, he joined the faculty of IIT Madras, his alma mater, in 2006.

His interest areas include Infrastructure planning and management, risk assessment and allocation, mechanisms for shaping successful infrastructure projects and cross-cultural issues in global infrastructure projects. His consultancy work includes varied assignments converging many varied subjects like sustainable development, social entrepreneurship, Public Private Partnerships in Infrastructure projects, Project Management, Organizational Behaviour, Disaster Management, and using cutting edge information technology in construction management.

His recent research work includes improving performance of Tsunami Housing Projects and developing a Databook for benchmarking Indian Water Utilities for the ADB. He is also a member of Engineers for a Sustainable World and American Society of Civil Engineers. He was awarded the Young Faculty Recognition Award from IIT Madras, Distinguished Service Award and Best paper Award from Engineering Project Organizational Society.

Dr. Ashwin brings his intense passion and unique expertise in blending technology and sustainability in infrastructure development and urbanization to add value to CUBE’s various domains of work.

teamMembers.name: Prof. Indumathi M Nambi
teamMembers.bio:
Dr. Indumathi Nambi is Associate Professor and Head of the Environment and Water Resources Division in the Department of Civil Engineering at IIT Madras. Prior to joining IIT Madras, she worked as a consultant at M.S. Swaminathan Research Foundation. Between 1994-2000, she was a Research Assistant at Clarkson University, USA and served as a Design Engineer at Larsen and Toubro between 1993 to 1994.

Dr. Indumathi is a Ph.D. in Civil and Environmental Engineering from Clarkson University, Potsdam, New York, M.E. (Env.) from Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai and B.E. (Civil) from College of Engineering, Anna University, Chennai.

Her research experience and interests include Ground water – state of contamination and transport, Remediation of contaminated soil and groundwater - Chromium, Petroleum compound pesticide & micro pollutants, Hazardous chemicals - Risk assessment and management, Water Treatment, Wastewater reuse, Solid waste management, Industrial Waste Water Treatment - Electro plating, tannery and textile, Environment Impact Assessment, Electro-chemical methods for contaminated water & Soil, Biogas from food waste, Micro-fuel cells coupled waste water treatment & Chromium recovery, Petro Chemical waste & waste water treatment and Removal of antibiotics & antimicrobial resistance in water system. She has published more than 25 journal publications and is constantly engaged in consultancy projects in Tamil Nadu and throughout the country as an Environmental Expert.

teamMembers.name: Mr. K V Rangaswami
teamMembers.bio:
Mr. Rangaswami retired as the Member of the Board and President - Larsen & Toubro Limited in June 2011 and was the Advisor to the Chairman, Larsen & Toubro Limited till June 2014. He headed the Operations of the ECC Division-L&T, the largest construction organization in India which operates in Middle East, Africa, SAARC and far-East countries apart from India. Post retirement, besides being the Advisor to Chairman, he is also the Chairman of the Board of two independent unlisted internal companies of L&T – Metallurgical Material Handling Independent Company & Infrastructure Independent Company. After completing B. Tech from IIT-Madras he joined ECC (A fully owned subsidiary of L&T at that time) in 1965 and since then he has been contributing immensely to the growth of L&T in various roles and capacities. He has been instrumental in designing innovative and cost-effective designs for many structures, some of them conceived and designed for the first time in India. He became Director in the year 2005.

He is also a member of the Board of Governors of National Institute of Construction Management & Research (NICMAR), Fellow of the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE), Fellow of the Institution of Civil Engineers-UK, Board Member - IIT RAM, Ahmedabad.

He has several awards attributed to him including “Economic Times ACETECH 2007” Award for professional ethics, achievements and rare contribution in the field of construction & environmental friendly architecture, Distinguished Alumnus Award-2002 - IIT Madras, “Outstanding Concrete Engineer of Tamil Nadu” for the year 2010 from Indian Concrete Institute, Tamil Nadu Chapter, “Life Time Achievement” – An Infrastructure & Construction Industry recognition, Awards from EPC World 2013.

Whilst all these are the core of his activities, he makes it a point to dedicate time and support to contribute something to the society.

teamMembers.name: Mr. B. Santhanam
teamMembers.bio:
Mr. Santhanam has extensive experience in the Glass product development and manufacturing industry having worked with the leading glass manufacturing and products firm Saint Gobain for more than 15 years. He is B. Tech (Civil) from IIT Madras, a “Distinguished Aumunus” of IITM, and a Postgraduate from IIM Ahmedabad.

He was Chairman CII Southern Region between 2013-2014 and is a elected member of National Council - Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)- 2006-Present. He was appointed to the Anna University Syndicate by Govt Of TN representing Industry-2013-2016. He has held several positions of eminence in various organizations including, Chairman of the CII National Committee - HR, Skills 2006-10, Chairman of the Southern Regional Committee on Water, Environment, Energy & Climate Change at Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), President of Employers' Federation of India (EFI)-2009-10, One of the Founder Directors of IIT Madras Research Park and Chairman PAN IIT 2008 Event.

Winner of several accolades and awards including “Champion of Humanity Award” by Hindustan Chamber of Commerce (2015) and V.C. Padmanaban Memorial Award” in the category of “Business Excellence leading to Development of Society at large” by Manappuram Finance Limited, he is deeply associated with developmental and humanitarian causes. Santhanam is very active in advocating diversity in work force and has been a champion of the newly created “Indian Women Network” (IWN) as part of the diversity agenda of CII. Currently, he is working as President and Managing Director of Flat Glass – South Asia, Malaysia & Egypt besides being a passionate guiding member of the Governing Body of CUBE. His areas of expertise include greenfield start up, business strategy, competitive analysis, HR, government relationships, macro-economic and social policies.

teamMembers.name: Mr. Sivaraman Krishnamurthy
teamMembers.bio:
Mr. Sivaraman is a B. Tech (Mech) from IIT Madras has over three decades of experience spanning engineering, maintenance, manufacturing and operations, projects, customer service, environment, health, safety and sustainability. He has worked in ITC Limited for more than twenty years in several roles and has played significant role in various Quality initiatives of ITC’s units and in interactions with regulatory bodies having also spearheaded various environment initiatives in ITC Ltd. He is an experienced professional having travelled widely abroad in connection with vendor appraisals, customer meetings and international exhibitions. He is also a CII certified Sustainability Assessor.

He currently works as an Advisor with various organisations as well as an Independent Consultant on Environment and Sustainability with organizations like Industrial Waste Management Association (IWMA) and IGCS (Indo German Centre for Sustainability, IIT Madras on environment projects for industry, society and Government of Tamil Nadu.

teamMembers.name: Mr. Srinivasa Raghavan Venkatachari
teamMembers.bio: Mr. Raghavan works with Tata Consultancy Services as Head of Digital Citizen and Connected Social Systems Research and Innovation Program within the CTO R&D Organization. This program focuses on Smart Cities beyond a purely infrastructure-focused view, by building digital systems which help key stakeholders such as Citizens, Communities and Businesses to reimagine Quality of Life experiences in a Smart City. These solutions will become critical in the adoption of Smart Cities for the benefit of all. As a versatile technology professional with over two decades of IT experience, he has consulted with and built technology solutions for customers in various industries and geographies. In his previous role he was the Practice Head for Cloud Computing Incubation within CTO R&D. Raghavan holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi and a Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.
